banner_enabled.description: Show/hide the site-wide announcement banner below the nav. Flip to true and set banner_text to publish a message with no code change or redeploy.

banner_text.description: Announcement banner message text, e.g. "Board of Commissioners meets tonight, 6pm." Only shown when banner_enabled is true.

banner_link.description: Optional URL for the banner's link (e.g. a civic-notes post or an external event page). Leave empty to show the banner with text only.

banner_link_label.description: Link text shown when banner_link is set.
